CREATE TABLE admissions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	reserved_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_admissions_business_id ON admissions (business_id)

CREATE TABLE businesses (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	canonical_host VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (site_id), 
	UNIQUE (canonical_host)
)

CREATE TABLE cases (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (id, business_id, environment_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_cases_business_id ON cases (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_cases_environment_id ON cases (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE edge_nonces (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE case_sources (
	source_system VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_record_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (environment_id, source_system, site_id, source_record_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(case_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES cases (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_case_sources_business_id ON case_sources (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_case_sources_environment_id ON case_sources (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE conversations (
	case_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	need_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (id, business_id, environment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(case_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES cases (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_business_id ON conversations (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_environment_id ON conversations (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES conversations (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, kind, revision)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_business_id ON artifacts (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_conversation_id ON artifacts (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_environment_id ON artifacts (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE contacts (
	channel VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES conversations (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, channel)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_contacts_business_id ON contacts (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_contacts_conversation_id ON contacts (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_contacts_environment_id ON contacts (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE conversation_events (
	event_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES conversations (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, event_key), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversation_events_business_id ON conversation_events (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversation_events_conversation_id ON conversation_events (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversation_events_environment_id ON conversation_events (environment_id)

CREATE TABLE jobs (
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	run_after TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	owner VARCHAR, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES conversations (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, kind)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_business_id ON jobs (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_conversation_id ON jobs (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_environment_id ON jobs (environment_id)
CREATE INDEX jobs_ready ON jobs (state, run_after)

CREATE TABLE outbox (
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	business_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	environment_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, business_id, environment_id) REFERENCES conversations (id, business_id, environment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (action_key)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_business_id ON outbox (business_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_conversation_id ON outbox (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_environment_id ON outbox (environment_id)
